messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — I need to land PR #26789 (small telemetry tweak) before tomorrow's maintenance freeze at 2024-08-12 11:00 UTC. CI showing mac_e2e stuck at 1/5 for ~45m. Can someone trigger a rerun or advise? Need one approver.

Ben: @Maria I can requeue mac after lunch. CI dashboard shows a flakey timeout in the screenshot Maria pasted. Pinging @CI Bot to re-run the mac job.

CI Bot: Build requeue requested by Ben for commit a1b2c3 (PR 26789). Re-running mac_e2e job now. Estimated time ~12 minutes.

Ashley: I can give a quick review — ETA 10m. Any merge conflicts with main?

Maria: No conflicts locally. I did `git fetch && git rebase origin/main` earlier; clean. Also added the canary flag in config (no schema changes).

DevOps: Heads up: maintenance blackout window is 11:00 UTC. If this lands within 30m of blackout the canary traffic won't fully warm. Suggest target merge at 09:30–09:45 UTC to leave buffer for rollback if needed.

Ben: Ack. I'll hold merge until approver + green CI. If CI finishes early we can aim for 09:35 UTC per DevOps.

Ashley: Left a tiny nit about a log message but not blocking. Approving now (LGTM). :white_check_mark:

CI Bot: mac_e2e: PASSED on rerun #2. All checks green. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/26789/a1b2c3.

Ravi: If you need me to sign off on a freeze exception I can, but prefer shipping in the safe window DevOps suggested. Any risk to telemetry consumers?

Maria: No risk — telemetry only, no protobuf/consumer changes. Scheduling merge at 09:35 UTC to match the warmup window.

Ben: Will merge at 09:35. Command I plan to run: ```./scripts/merge-pr.sh 26789 --canary --no-auto-rollout```

Ravi: 👍 I'll watch canary metrics for 15 minutes and have rollback plan ready (toggle via feature flag /ops/telemetry-toggle).

Maria: Thanks all — appreciate the quick eyes. Will post results once canary is stable.
